prompt: Choose the best sentence for the blank.
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的句子。

options.text: Anyone going to the library should get off at the temporary stop and follow the sign outside.
options.zh: 要去圖書館的人都應在臨時站下車，再看外面的指示。
options.whyZh: 臨時站只能上車，不能下車。

options.text: The two-minute adjustment also moves the scheduled arrival time of every stop on the route.
options.zh: 兩分鐘的調整也會變更整條路線每站的預定到站時間。
options.whyZh: 公車仍按通常時刻行駛，兩分鐘是花園門站相對圖書館原定發車時間，不是全線延誤。

options.text: To get off near the library without using stairs, use Garden Gate rather than the temporary stop.
options.zh: 若想在圖書館附近下車且不走樓梯，請到花園門站下車，不要在臨時站下車。
options.whyZh: 臨時站只能上車；花園門站的坡道可供上下車，兩處限制合起來才能找到適合的下車站。

options.text: If you cannot manage stairs, remain at the old library curb and wait for Route 8 to stop there.
options.zh: 如果無法走樓梯，請留在圖書館原站等八號公車停靠。
options.whyZh: 原站已封閉，且有坡道的替代站是花園門站。

explanationZh: 臨時站只能上車；花園門站的坡道可供上下車，兩處限制合起來才能找到適合的下車站。

vocabulary.note: 不需上下階梯即可通行。

evidence:
Route 8 rider notice
Subject: Saturday stop diversion

Road work will close the curb beside East Library on Saturday. The bus will still run on its usual schedule, but it will no longer stop there. A sign at the closed curb will direct riders to the temporary stop behind the library.

The temporary stop can be reached from Lake Street. Riders who cannot use stairs should instead board at Garden Gate, where a ramp connects the bus entrance and exit to the sidewalk. The bus visits Garden Gate two minutes after its scheduled library departure.

The temporary stop is for boarding only; it cannot be used to get off the bus. To get off near the library without using stairs, use Garden Gate rather than the temporary stop.

The Sunday schedule and stop locations are unchanged; the diversion applies on Saturday only.
